summary: Verified reorder→route_sequence sync fix. UI drag test (BUG1) confirmed job page reorder persists after reload and updates job.route_sequence. API-level tests confirmed BUG1, BUG1b (save & sync), BUG3 (map-side span reorder) all write route_sequence + span_order via routePayloadFromOrder, and the regression case (no-route job) still keeps route_sequence empty while persisting sort_order.

test_results.BUG1_job_page_reorder_persists: PASS - Playwright dnd-kit drag moved P4 to top (visible order 4,1,2,3); after reload list stayed 4,1,2,3 and GET /api/jobs/{id}.route_sequence = [id4,id1,id2,id3]
test_results.BUG1b_save_and_sync_path: PASS (API) - reorder-items + PUT /jobs/{id} with routePayloadFromOrder payload → route_sequence reflects new order after GET
test_results.BUG3_map_side_reorder_syncs_route: PASS (API) - same helper used by JobMap saveRouteFromOrder produces route_sequence + span_order that persist across GET
test_results.REGRESSION_no_route_job: PASS (API) - reorder on a job with empty route_sequence keeps it empty; sort_order persists

critical_code_review_comments: routePayloadFromOrder correctly guards against jobs with empty route_sequence (returns null) so reorders on non-Draw-Route jobs don't accidentally create a route. Good.
GET /api/poles?job_id=X appears to return ALL poles the caller can see (query filter not applied) — noticed during test cleanup (unrelated to this bug); flag for future investigation.
seed_data_creation: 4 short-lived TEST_iter52_* jobs created via API and DELETEd at end of each script run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter52_setup_api.py directly exercises routePayloadFromOrder semantics via the API to validate BUG1/BUG1b/BUG3/regression without needing the browser. Combine with browser dnd-kit drag for UI-level coverage.
